note: THE economy table (PLAN.md 1.4 / F3). Prices are yen, CS 1.6's dollars x 10 for the guns (the damage is CS 1.6's too, user 2026-10-08). A weapon you already carry is a REFILL at refill_fraction of its price; a supply is priced per unit and a purchase tops the stack up to its max. Bills (hospital, police per star, ransom) are crimes.json's 'fees' and gangs.json's 'abduction' -- RecoveryRules reads them there, and they may run a balance into debt (CR4). Robbery is each clerk's till. Every yen moves through game.profile.Economy.transfer. A row missing here is FREE and is logged once.
